title: Echoes of Home
logline: A stranded astronaut drifts through the silence of a forgotten space station, chasing the light of Earth.

scenes.description: A lone astronaut floats through the dimly lit corridors of an abandoned space station, their breath visible in the cold air.
They pass a reflective window, revealing Earth in the distance, glowing softly under the sun.
The astronaut reaches for a flickering control panel, trying to activate a dormant system.
They float past a row of dormant pods, each one silently holding the remnants of past missions.
The astronaut spots a faint light pulsing from a faraway corridor, hinting at a possible path forward.
They drift toward the light, their silhouette framed against the vastness of space and Earth.
